blocks.text: 感謝信

日期：2026 年 5 月 6 日
受文者：長昇精密工業股份有限公司 陳素芬 經理

陳經理鈞鑒：

敝公司新產線已於上月順利量產，謹代表全體同仁向貴公司致上最誠摯的謝意。

三月初模具調校不如預期，交期一度面臨延宕。貴公司在接獲通知的當日即派員南下支援，連續三天協同我方工程團隊完成參數校正，使產線得以如期啟動。這份不推諉、不計較的協助，我們記在心裡。

特別感謝貴公司品保部門主動提供的材質檢驗報告。那份資料讓我們在客戶稽核時免去一次可能的重工，價值遠超過報告本身。

後續第二季的擴線計畫，仍盼能與貴公司繼續合作。專此函謝。

明衡科技有限公司
總經理　王文彥　敬啟
Thank-You Letter

Date: 6 May 2026
To: Ms. S. F. Chen, Changsheng Precision Co., Ltd.

Dear Ms. Chen,

Our new production line entered volume production last month, and I am writing on behalf of the whole team to thank you sincerely.

When tooling calibration fell behind in early March, the schedule was at real risk. Your company sent engineers to our site the same day we raised it, and worked alongside our team for three consecutive days to complete the parameter corrections. The line started on time because of that. We have not forgotten it.

We are especially grateful to your quality assurance team for providing the material inspection reports unprompted. That documentation spared us a likely rework during a customer audit — worth considerably more than the reports themselves.

We hope to continue working with you on the second-phase expansion this quarter. With sincere thanks.

Yours sincerely,

W. Y. Wang
General Manager
Minghen Technology Ltd.

blocks.text: 第二季產線擴充檢討會議紀錄

cells: 第二季產線擴充檢討會議
桃園廠 三樓第一會議室
王文彥、周明德（生產部）、林佳蓉（採購部）、蔡雅琳（財務部）、張建豪（品保部）
陳素芬（長昇精密，第三案列席）

blocks.text: 一、報告事項

（一）生產部報告：第一條產線三月份稼動率 87%，較目標 85% 高出 2 個百分點；不良率 1.2%，主要集中在軸承座壓入工序。
（二）採購部報告：長昇精密第一、二批交貨均如期完成，驗收無異常。第三批預計 4 月 28 日到貨。
（三）財務部報告：擴線預算執行率 42%，尚在控制範圍。
二、討論與決議事項

案由一：壓入工序不良率偏高。
說明：張建豪提出三月不良品 62 件中有 51 件源自壓入力道設定。
決議：由品保部於四月底前完成壓力參數重新驗證，並提出標準作業程序修訂草案。全體同意。

案由二：第二條產線設備採購時程。
說明：周明德說明設備商交期為下訂後 16 週，若五月底前未下訂，第三季量產將延後。
決議：授權採購部於 4 月 30 日前完成比價並簽核，預算上限新臺幣 850 萬元。全體同意。

案由三：與長昇精密的年度框架協議。
說明：陳經理列席說明，雙方擬將現行逐案報價改為年度框架合約，價格按年度總量分級。
決議：原則同意，細節由採購部與對方擬定草案，下次會議討論。保留一票（蔡雅琳，認為需先確認年度用量預估準確度）。
三、追蹤交辦事項

cells: 壓力參數重新驗證並提出 SOP 修訂草案
第二條產線設備比價與簽核
年度用量預估重新試算
上次會議第 3 案（倉儲動線調整）結案報告

Q2 Line Expansion Review — Meeting Minutes

cells: W. Y. Wang, M. D. Chou (Production), J. R. Lin (Procurement), Y. L. Tsai (Finance), C. H. Chang (QA)
S. F. Chen (Changsheng Precision, item 3 only)

blocks.text: 1. Reports

(1) Production: Line 1 ran at 87% utilisation in March against an 85% target. Defect rate 1.2%, concentrated in the bearing-housing press-fit step.
(2) Procurement: Changsheng delivered batches 1 and 2 on schedule; acceptance found no issues. Batch 3 is due 28 April.
(3) Finance: 42% of the expansion budget committed, within plan.
2. Discussion and Resolutions

Item 1 — High defect rate at the press-fit step.
Background: C. H. Chang reported 51 of 62 March defects traced to press-force settings.
Resolved: QA to re-validate the pressure parameters by end of April and draft a revised standard operating procedure. Agreed unanimously.

Item 2 — Equipment procurement schedule for Line 2.
Background: M. D. Chou noted a 16-week lead time from order. Ordering after end of May would delay Q3 production.
Resolved: Procurement authorised to complete price comparison and sign off by 30 April, with a ceiling of NT$8.5 million. Agreed unanimously.

Item 3 — Annual framework agreement with Changsheng Precision.
Background: Ms. Chen attended to propose replacing case-by-case quotations with an annual framework contract priced by volume tier.
Resolved: Agreed in principle. Procurement to draft terms with the supplier for discussion at the next meeting. One abstention (Y. L. Tsai, pending confidence in annual volume forecasts).
3. Action Items

cells: Re-validate press parameters; draft revised SOP
Line 2 equipment price comparison and sign-off
J. R. Lin, S. F. Chen
